name: Sodium Rutin Sulfate
description: Sodium Rutin Sulfate (CAS 12768-44-4 ), also known as Disodium Rutinyl Disulfate, is a water-soluble sulfated derivative of rutin developed to overcome poor aqueous solubility. It functions as an antioxidant and bioactive ingredient in pharmaceutical and nutraceutical applications where aqueous compatibility is a requirement. In pharmaceutical manufacturing, it is incorporated into oral and topical dosage forms targeting vascular protection and capillary fragility. Improved water solubility supports consistent dosing and bioavailability in these specialized medical applications. Nutraceutical and dietary supplement producers use it in liquid formats including drinks, ampoules, and syrups where standard rutin cannot be adequately dispersed. This allows for more versatile delivery systems in the health and wellness sector. Functional food and beverage formulators source it as an antioxidant ingredient for products requiring a water-miscible flavonoid with label-friendly positioning. It provides a stable solution for enhancing the nutritional profile of consumer goods. Topical cosmeceutical preparations also incorporate it for its antioxidant activity in aqueous-based serums and creams. Its ability to remain stable in water-based formulas makes it a preferred choice for high-end skincare manufacturers. The product is supplied as a fine powder, typically in off-white to light yellow form. It is available in pharmaceutical-grade and food-grade specifications to meet the sourcing requirements of various regulated global markets. Bulk quantities are standard for industrial buyers, with smaller research quantities available from specialty suppliers.
